ngspice.classificationBasis: Zero total rejects, not separately instrumented categories; breakpoint clipping is not counted as rejection.

hashLayout: Row-major float64 little-endian: time, node voltages in map order, branch currents in map order. Observed initial row comes from baseline; every accepted advance is independently observed. Unlike round-3's column-major hash.
timingCaveat: One baseline simulate call and one callback-enabled stepping call, both wrapped. Different result-construction scopes, shared host, no speed/overhead claim.
waveformErrorChange: None for observed accepted advances relative to baseline; existing ngspice waveform loss remains. No new ngspice waveform error measurement.
commands: pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/analysis/transient-rejection-1310.test.ts src/analysis/transient-charge-lte.test.ts
